title: Business Executive - Indore
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial growth and build trusted, professional relationships with healthcare partners across Indore. Your role involves designing and delivering territory plans that drive business outcomes while supporting improved patient care. We seek clear communicators who act with integrity, curiosity, and practical commercial thinking. This role offers meaningful impact, strong learning opportunities, and the chance to work with a team united by science and technology to get ahead of disease together. Join us to grow your career and make a real difference. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Build and maintain trusted, professional relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams, and institutional partners across Indore. - Design, execute, and monitor territory business plans that meet commercial targets and support better patient outcomes. - Conduct professional visits and educational meetings to share clear, evidence-based information responsibly. - Gather market and customer insights to refine plans and improve performance locally. - Collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and ensure timely, quality delivery. - Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and local regulations. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution; a background in science, pharmacy, or medicine is an advantage. - 1 to 3 years of experience in customer-facing roles such as sales, field roles, or account management. - Strong spoken and written communication skills in English and relevant local languages spoken in Indore (e.g., Hindi, Marathi). - Comfortable using digital tools like Word, Excel, and mobile reporting applications. - Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory. - Customer-focused mindset with integrity and a commitment to ethical conduct. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Previous experience in healthcare, hospital, or pharmaceutical field roles. - Ability to clearly explain clinical or scientific information to diverse audiences. - Planning, organisation, and analytical skills to develop and monitor territory performance. - Experience organising professional meetings or educational events. - Comfortable working independently and as part of a cross-functional team. - Fluency in additional regional languages relevant to Indore and surrounding areas. Work pattern and location This role is on-site in Indore with regular travel across the assigned territory. Most of your time will be spent in the field, building relationships and engaging with healthcare teams. Some flexible time for administrative work may be possible. Ready to apply? If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we want to hear from you. Please share your CV and a brief note telling us why you are excited about this opportunity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people who value inclusion to apply. Join us and help unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

**Skills**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Area Sales Manager - Automotive Aftermarket | Franchise Development & Support | Indore
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

**Job Description:**

Work Location: Indore

**Role Summary**

Responsible for driving franchise development and business growth within the Automotive Aftermarket segment by identifying and onboarding new franchise partners, expanding the outlet network, and strengthening existing franchise operations. The role will focus on driving revenue growth, ensuring consistent service quality and operational excellence, supporting franchise partners with sales and marketing initiatives, and ensuring adherence to brand standards, product availability, and customer experience expectations across all franchise locations.

**1. Franchise Development**

* Identify and onboard new franchise partners.
* Conduct franchise presentations and business discussions.
* Evaluate franchise applications and financial capabilities.
* Coordinate franchise agreements and onboarding documentation.

**2. Franchise Operations & Support**

* Ensure franchise outlets comply with brand SOPs and service standards.
* Provide operational guidance and training to franchise partners.
* Monitor outlet performance, productivity and profitability.
* Conduct periodic outlet audits and performance reviews.

**3. Revenue & Business Growth**

* Drive sales and revenue targets across franchise locations.
* Support franchisees in executing marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including revenue, footfall, customer retention and average billing.
* Identify business expansion opportunities and potential markets.

**4. Franchise Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Address operational challenges and resolve partner concerns.
* Act as a key liaison between franchise outlets and the corporate team.

**5. Training & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with brand guidelines, pricing policies and hygiene standards.
* Coordinate product procurement and vendor management.
* Organize training programs to enhance franchise staff capabilities and service quality.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Automotive Engineering or any related discipline.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in the Automotive Aftermarket industry, preferably in franchise development, dealer management, channel sales or business operations.
* Experience in developing franchise networks, managing channel partners and driving business growth.
* Strong understanding of automotive aftermarket products, distribution networks and service operations.

Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.

title: Senior Technical Manager

in Microsoft Azure, .NET Core/.NET 6+, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST Web APIs, and Microservices architecture.** Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, SQL (Solutions Architect, Developer, Administrator) and exposure to AI-enabled tools or OpenAI integrations are highly desirable.About usInfoBeans, founded in 2000, is a publicly listed company on the NSE InfoBeans Foundation, our CSR arm, helps underprivileged sections of society become employable through our free one-year training programs.Creating WOW! is not just a tagline for us; it’s our religion!
